title: BECE English Studies: Reading Comprehension - English Studies - Comprehension - Following Directions
subject: English Studies

questions.q:
*(Refer to the comprehension passage in Question 1)*

According to the step-by-step instructions in the passage, what must you do immediately **after** placing the sapling gently in the center of the hole?
options: Dig a hole twice as wide as the root ball.
Fill in the rest of the soil completely.
Fill the hole half-way with the excavated soil.
questions.explain: This question tests following step-by-step directions. The passage outlines: 'Second, place the sapling gently in the center... Next, fill the hole half-way with the excavated soil...' Therefore, filling the hole half-way is the immediate next step.

questions.q:
*(Refer to the comprehension passage in Question 31)*

According to the step-by-step instructions for building a terrace, what must be placed immediately **after** the gravel is used for backfilling?
options: A thick layer of compost-enriched topsoil.
questions.explain: The passage outlines the sequential steps clearly: '...backfilled with gravel for drainage, followed by a thick layer of compost-enriched topsoil.' Therefore, the topsoil comes immediately after the gravel.
